scope: Togo medical discovery — Université de Kara Faculty of Health Sciences

verifiedFacts.claim: Université de Kara's Faculty of Health Sciences page lists a State Doctorate in Medicine among its programmes and describes hospital placement sites as its Espace CHU.

The faculty's official admissions information requires a scientific baccalaureate (C, D or E) and review of secondary-school marks; the general 2026/27 admissions page requires foreign students to obtain university homologation and authorisation before enrolment.
The faculty page says the academic year is 32 weeks over two semesters and that placements are assessed teaching units.
Togo's official 2025/26 recognised-institutions announcement lists Université de Kara among the country's public universities.

holdReasons: No current Medicine tuition, mandatory-fee schedule or full cost breakdown was located on an official source.
The 2026/27 general admissions page does not provide Medicine-specific deadline, document checklist, selection outcome or programme fee information.
Instructional language, named clinical partners, scholarship/loan support, accommodation and professional-registration pathway remain unverified.
nextAction: Obtain a current FSS Medicine call, fee decision and placement agreement details, then verify language, international eligibility, support and registration evidence before packaging content.
